3119.title: Pi update chooses the wrong global package manager
3119.rootCauseOneLine: Pi maintenance resolves the active executable but constructs both update surfaces with npm unconditionally.

prReviews.topFinding: The closed diff targets package-manager selection but adds Pi-specific synchronous filesystem policy to the generic toolkit without tests and conflicts with repository rules.

3119.proposedFix: Detect whether the resolved Pi executable belongs to Bun's global bin and use a Bun global add command for both advertised and executable maintenance plans, with npm as the fallback.
3119.caveats: The exact reporter filesystem was not accessed; two isolated checkouts reproduced the equivalent wrapper-to-Bun ownership case.
